exposure: Maternal gestational weight gain (GWG) during dietary treatment (restricted, appropriate, excessive)
outcome: Maternal HbA1c (from diagnosis to late pregnancy)
Prevalence of infants born small for gestational age
cohort: The study included 382 women consecutively diagnosed with gestational diabetes (GDM) before 34 weeks' gestation who had live singleton births.
finding: Restricted gestational weight gain during dietary treatment was associated with healthier fetal growth and lower infant birthweight-SD scores, without an increased prevalence of infants born small for gestational age.
birth_weight: Infant birthweight-SD score (e.g., 0.59 +- 1.6 for excessive GWG group, 0.15 +- 1.1 for restricted GWG group)
